# Quantitative Finance Club @ UCF

Quantitative Finance Club @ UCF gives students a place to explore financial markets through mathematics, statistics, programming, and research.

The club organizes workshops, research initiatives, projects, guest talks, career events, and discussions about financial markets.

## Key Pages

- Home: https://quantucf.com/
- About: https://quantucf.com/about/
- Events: https://quantucf.com/events/
- Projects: https://quantucf.com/projects/
- Posts: https://quantucf.com/posts/
- Officers: https://quantucf.com/officers/
- Sponsors: https://quantucf.com/sponsors/
- Join: https://quantucf.com/join/
